name: M5.Period.cyclic_dvd_iff_root_pow
statement: ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (N : ℕ), F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ (AdjoinRoot.root F) ^ N = 1
guidance: Use AdjoinRoot.mk_eq_zero after unfolding cyclicModulus, and map_add/map_pow/map_one/mk_X. The quotient is characteristic two: CharTwo.neg_eq or add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg removes minus one. This includes N = 0 and F = 1. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
